cards.mood: The piece opens with a tense, mechanical atmosphere that quickly erupts into high-octane aggression.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars provide the core harmonic foundation, playing tight, palm-muted chugging riffs in the verses and opening up into sustained, ringing power chords during the choruses.
